caption: The drawing depicts a horizontal ornamental border placed in the upper center area of the paper, consisting of two main sections. The upper section features a repeated pattern of semicircular shapes in beige and light brown, outlined and detailed in white, with a background in a lighter beige. Below this, there is a thicker band predominantly colored in medium and dark blue, containing an interwoven, looping band pattern in beige, outlined in black, with small white dots along the inner edge of each loop. The background within the loops is medium blue, and the area outside of the looping pattern is a darker blue. The rest of the paper is a plain, solid light beige, with the lower right corner marked by a handwritten signature or note in pencil.
title: Wall Paper Border
